records.statement: SBI Remit's official 2023 announcement establishes an XRP-based ODL corridor expansion to the Philippines, Vietnam and Indonesia, but current 2026 corridor status, transaction volume, XRP turnover and market-maker inventory are not disclosed.
SBI Ripple Asia's 2026 tokenized-deposit work is a conceptual proof using XRPL. It does not establish production deployment or native XRP use as collateral/bridge asset.

The Visa crypto card automatically converts points monthly into the selected asset, but no aggregate card spend, points redemption, XRP amount, sourcing venue or net market purchase is disclosed. Merchant card spending is not itself XRP-denominated.

The JPY 10B SBI START bond principal is not XRP investment. The initial XRP benefit is 200 yen per JPY 100,000 for eligible subscriptions; actual eligible amount and XRP distributed are unknown. Future coupon-date XRP benefits were undecided and are not guaranteed.
The SBI Shinsei deposit campaign ended March 31, 2026. No eligible deposit total, coupon redemption or XRP amount distributed is disclosed; the coupon is not proof of market buying.
Two million registered SBI VC Trade accounts do not equal active users, funded accounts, XRP holders, XRP balances or trading volume.

SBI VC Trade's June 2026 RLUSD service supports Ethereum-chain RLUSD only at launch, not XRPL RLUSD. The listing therefore establishes Ripple stablecoin distribution in Japan, not RLUSD liquidity on XRPL through SBI.

SBI VC Trade describes RLUSD as a Type 4 electronic payment instrument under its Japanese-law classification, while Ripple says the launch followed JFSA regulatory approval. Preserve the exact legal descriptions; do not generalize this into approval of all RLUSD chains or all Ripple products.

JPYSC launched initially inside SBI VC Trade account balances; public-chain circulation was conditional on legal/tax clarification. September 7 lending applications are not funded loans. No JPYSC collateral utilization or Arc route is established.
SBI Group's 60% voting-rights ownership applies to SBI Ripple Asia, the joint venture with Ripple; it is not evidence that SBI owns 60% of Ripple Labs.

SBI Group's Circle/Arc/USDC/JPYSC relationships coexist with SBI's Ripple/XRP/RLUSD relationships. No exclusive routing, token preference, cross-ownership or direct Circle-Ripple agreement is established by these sources.
Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd. (SBIC East Japan) remains distinct from SBI Holdings/SBI Group. No affiliation between them is established by the reviewed sources.

XRP rewards through card points, bond benefits and term-deposit coupons are distribution incentives. They may be sourced from inventory or purchases, but no public evidence quantifies the net new market demand they create.

The SBI evidence establishes multiple institutional rails but does not provide synchronized XRP flows, fixed-horizon price outcomes or a calibrated causal model. No directional XRP forecast is justified.
